Question: A \(16\)-step path is to go from \((-4,-4)\) to \((4,4)\) with each step increasing either the \(x\)-coordinate or the \(y\)-coordinate by \(1.\) How many such paths stay outside or on the boundary of the square \(-2\le x\le2,\) \(-2\le y\le2\) at each step?
